title: Superb guided tour of Montserrat.
text: We recommend Alan Nicol without hesitation.  We had a private guided tour of the sites (May 8). He adapted the tour to our needs without hesitation. Mr. Nicol loves his work, and it shows throughout the tour. He is passionate!  His knowledge of the sites, both about the monastery and the mountain, is impressive.   We highly recommend him. We will keep a wonderful memory of it.
author: Journey45863367778

title: Montserrat Outstanding Francophone Guide
text:
Alan is a fantastic guide, helpful and a living encyclopedia. Very nice visit. To see in Barcelona. Merci. Claire and Pierre.
5 stars
author: PierreTR

title: Montserrat Monastery with Alan
text:
Alan was a wonderful Guide on all points: punctuality, good humor and communicative enthusiasm, history of Montserrat mountain and monastery with a host of more interesting anecdotes than each other, visit to the monastery coupled with a short hike. Everything was perfect!
And finally, he even told us the address of several restaurants (very convenient when you don't know the city) and provided some pictures of goats he had taken during another visit.
Alan is a Guide that I highly recommend! Again thank you to him for this great time spent with him...
author: 707fran_oiseb
